name: Crimes
overview: Scripture reveals that crimes, particularly the shedding of innocent blood, are serious offenses for which God demands accountability, as seen in Genesis 9:5. The authority to punish evil rests with governing authorities acting as ministers of God to execute justice and restrain wrongdoing (Romans 13:4). True obedience to Christ’s commandments reflects love for Him (John 14:15), and His unchanging nature (Hebrews 13:8) assures believers that His standards of righteousness and justice remain constant throughout all time.
